key_insight: Interactive Neural Computers learn to generate the next desktop screen from prior screens and user actions, modeling the computer itself rather than an agent that operates it.
engineering_relevance: Generative desktop models could enable adaptable workflows and accessible interfaces, provided they can reliably preserve state, compute exactly, and render readable text.
method: Train a Neural Turing Machine–style architecture end to end from pixels and actions.
Store off-screen content with surprise-gated slot memory supervised by latent next-frame prediction (MEMORY-JEPA).
Connect pretrained VLM reasoning through an exploratory query bridge and render only latent changes between frames.
evidence_signal: In long closed-loop rollouts, occluded-file recall reached 64.2% versus at most 56.0% for recurrent and sliding-window baselines (33.3% chance), while terminal-text OCR accuracy rose from 1.3% to 50.1%.
watch_item: Exact arithmetic remains a requirement rather than a demonstrated result in the abstract, and 50.1% terminal-text OCR accuracy leaves substantial reliability concerns.
